_meta.policy: Evidence-only review report; it does not authorize data changes outside the recorded gated apply decision.

review_scope: FinanceDatabase missing-company reconciliation: exact ISIN candidates only

apply.sector_policy: Leave stock_sector blank in the coverage source rows; the normal rebuild may retain an existing official fallback (observed for HEL::LEHTO and TPEX::5348), otherwise keep it blank.
